ENGLISH — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text.

2. When practising Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Nouns and Quantifiers.

3. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. run
   B. blue
   C. quickly
   D. happiness

6. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Literature: Short Forms, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Literature: Short Forms.

8. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the Library
   B. Where is the library
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

9. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. A person, place, thing, or idea
   B. Only a describing word
   C. Only a joining word
   D. Only an action

   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. One main idea with supporting sentences
   D. No full stops
